facts.fact: Decryptage reports that UNHCR and the Beninese authorities are working on the biometric integration of displaced people into the national register of natural persons (RNPP), with SP-CNRA annexes opened at Natitingou and Kandi, while 16,463 recognised refugees lack valid ID cards and about 12,400 asylum-seekers await formal registration.
